# Upgrade Your Bot

Not able to figure out how you can upgrade your bot to premium? Below you can find the instructions!

## How to upgrade your bot

### *<mark style="color:yellow;">Premium Subscriptions purchased post (after) March 15th 2025:</mark>*

**Just upgraded to a premium subscription? Awesome!**\
All the bots on your account have been automatically upgraded, no extra steps needed. Just refresh your browser, and start enjoying all the premium features of BotGhost!

{% hint style="info" %}
**The following bots are not upgraded:**

* Bots that are already upgraded with premium
* Bots that you are a collaborator of. Only bots created on your BotGhost account can be upgraded with your Premium subscription.
  {% endhint %}

{% hint style="info" %}
Should you have any questions about BotGhost's billing or subscription, please check out our [Help Center](https://help.botghost.com/support/home).
{% endhint %}

### *<mark style="color:red;">Premium subscriptions purchased pre (before) March 15th, 2025</mark>:*

{% hint style="info" %}
The following bots **can't** be upgraded:

* Bots that are already upgraded with premium,
* Bots that you are a collaborator of. You can only upgrade the bots on your BotGhost account.

If your bot is upgraded with premium, you must wait till this runs out to use your (other) premium subscription.
{% endhint %}

Just purchased a premium subscription and want to upgrade your bot? Follow these steps to upgrade your bot:

{% stepper %}
{% step %}
First, you'll need to locate your [BotGhost Dashboard settings](https://btghst.info/settings) in order to upgrade your bot:

![](https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FeYXPSapbKMrowVFdMC3B%2Fimage.png?alt=media\&token=e6902263-11cb-45a8-8823-ca6f3db6bed1)
{% endstep %}

{% step %}
At the top of your settings page, you should see an orange box with the message 'Premium Tokens Available'. To activate premium on that specific bot, press the 'Upgrade Bot' button!

![Note: Ensure you've selected the right bot before interacting with this button](https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FbT6dPmGazwGvCGrfUVNR%2Fimage.png?alt=media\&token=5189d792-d7ca-44dd-a10f-92900bb688fc)
{% endstep %}
{% endstepper %}
